scope: Holistic architectural-clay source identity, massing, roof topology, envelope, programme, contacts and visible circulation. Movement and browser performance are verified separately.
pixel_findings: The three-storey stucco mass, continuous deep upper-front loggia, open ground corner, iron balcony guards and long right-side pool retain the Mediterranean hotel identity in architectural-clay scope.
Dressed stone courses, deep window surrounds, layered foliage and trailing flowers preserve the corrected facade identity. Physical glazing exposes furnished spaces behind it.
Guest-suite artwork faces the room on solid between-window carriers. Courtyard artwork is supported on solid wall without crossing window openings.
The long pool has a continuous basin edge and coping with the water recessed below it.

The corner roof apertures retain shaped closed reveals. The added physical wall-head returns now close the former see-through slots between offset room partitions and reveal bases. The central court underside is continuous and seated.
The three corner apertures and long central roof court remain open to the sky. The roof repair leaves the occupied loggia and gallery space visually clear.

Physical stair treads and landing guards, open gallery routes, room furnishings, lobby seating and reception remain intact. No new P0/P1 interference or contact defect appears in the complete view set.

The corrected upper-loggia portal is shifted clear of the guest-wing wall and preserves the facade opening rhythm. The supplied carrier audit reports 84 openings and 756 rays with no blocked samples; an independent supplemental movement report records 194 passing samples through the repaired doorway in both directions.
source_interpretation: Front and oblique sources show a largely continuous hip roof; the exact top source shows three corner terrace cutouts and a long central roof court. The documented top-authoritative roof topology is accepted. Extending the central court to ground level and authoring interior rooms are explicit programme inferences.

resolved_findings.note: Physical wall-head returns bridge the laterally offset partition heads and reveal bases; the former background-visible slot is absent.
Portal moved east to clear the crossing wall. Carrier and actual-mesh doorway sweep reports both pass.

nonblocking_notes.note: Terracotta geometry still reads as continuous longitudinal corrugation. Restrained transverse tile courses and hip caps could improve later polish.
Foliage and furnishings remain stylized clay. Their present coverage and physical contacts are sufficient for this pilot scope.

limitations: Architectural-clay approval only; no photographic texture keeper approval.
Interior programme, hidden rear continuation and ground-level court are authored inference.

Carrier audit is limited to opaque carriers; walking reports cover their defined movement samples. This visual review does not establish browser performance, engineering, accessibility or terrain grounding.
inspection_method: Independently inspected all 19 v006 exact-GLB reimport renders, all three v006 phone boards and all three locked source images at original resolution. Repeated holistic identity, envelope, roof, contact, interior and circulation review. Inspected carrier-aperture audit and exact-hash walking/portal reports as supporting geometric evidence. Source/script and GLB hashes verified.
